notes: The Cuenca round is the Copa de España de Pukas (Pukas Race), run by Madrid Downhill Club and Urethane Burners. Each round has its own local organiser (Cullera: L'Horta Downhill Club; Polopos: Polopos Freeride), so sponsorship is bought round by round. IG @cndownhill is correct.
